en_title: The Witcher 3 and Assassin's Creed 'Reset Player Expectations' for Open-World Action RPGs, So the Fable Reboot Devs Had to Look Beyond the Original Trilogy for Inspiration
cn_title: 《巫师3》和《刺客信条》「重塑了玩家对开放世界动作RPG的期待」，因此《神鬼寓言》重启版开发者不得不从原版三部曲之外寻找灵感
opus_summary: Playground Games联合创始人Ralph Fulton表示，《巫师3》及《Assassin's Creed》系列向RPG转型不断重塑玩家期待，因此《神鬼寓言》重启版不能只从原三部曲中寻找灵感。游戏计划于2027年2月23日登陆PC、PS5及XBOX Series X和S。

paragraphs.en: Why has the Fable reboot taken so long to develop? There are a number of reasons, but part of it is that expectations around open-world action RPGs were reset by various competing games over the past decade.
paragraphs.cn: 《神鬼寓言》重启版为何开发了这么久？原因有很多，其中一部分是过去十年间，各种竞争游戏重塑了玩家对开放世界动作RPG的期待。

paragraphs.en: Work on Fable reportedly started in 2016, and only now, 10 years later, is it near release. It’s suffered a tumultuous development but, unlike some other costly Microsoft gaming projects, it has avoided closure amid sweeping layoffs and restructuring at Xbox.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，《神鬼寓言》于2016年开始开发，直到10年后的现在才接近发售。它的开发过程经历了动荡，但与微软其他一些耗资巨大的游戏项目不同，它在XBOX大规模裁员和重组中避免了被砍掉的命运。

paragraphs.en: In a new interview with GamesIndustry.biz , Playground Games co-founder and Fable general manager Ralph Fulton touched on the trials and tribulations Fable has endured over the years. Playground set up a new team to make Fable in addition to its hugely popular racing game franchise, Forza Horizon, and set out to make a game in a genre it had no prior experience with. And Fable is a big role-playing game, with all the bells and whistles you'd expect. So, Fable isn’t technically a debut game from Playground, but it sort of is.
paragraphs.cn: 在最近接受GamesIndustry.biz采访时，Playground Games联合创始人兼《神鬼寓言》总经理Ralph Fulton谈到了《神鬼寓言》多年来经历的种种考验和磨难。除了开发广受欢迎的竞速游戏系列《极限竞速：地平线》之外，Playground还组建了一支新团队来制作《神鬼寓言》，着手开发一款属于其此前从未涉足过的类型的游戏。而《神鬼寓言》是一款大型角色扮演游戏，具备你所期待的各种功能。因此，严格来说，《神鬼寓言》并不是Playground的首款游戏，但某种程度上又算是。

paragraphs.en: In terms of what’s changed, Fulton said that technology had “advanced” during development, pointing to a reset of player expectations with the release of CD Projekt’s fantasy RPG masterpiece The Witcher 3 and then Assassin’s Creed’s move towards the RPG genre.
paragraphs.cn: 谈及发生了哪些变化，Fulton表示，技术在开发期间「进步了」。他指出，随着CD Projekt的奇幻RPG杰作《巫师3》发售，以及之后《刺客信条》向RPG类型转型，玩家的期待发生了改变。

paragraphs.en: This, Fulton explained, meant that Playground had to look beyond the original Fable trilogy for inspiration to ensure it created a reboot that would meet modern open-world standards.
paragraphs.cn: Fulton解释说，这意味着Playground必须从《神鬼寓言》原版三部曲之外寻找灵感，以确保打造出一款符合现代开放世界标准的重启作品。

paragraphs.en: “In 2015, The Witcher 3 redefined what an open-world action RPG looks like and became the gold standard,” Fulton explained. “And after that bar was raised, the Assassin's Creed franchise changed into this more modern iteration with Origins, Odyssey, and Valhalla, and became like a quasi-RPG.
paragraphs.cn: 「2015年，《巫师3》重新定义了开放世界动作RPG的样貌，并成为了黄金标准，」Fulton解释说。「在这一标准被提高之后，《刺客信条》系列通过《刺客信条：起源》《刺客信条：奥德赛》和《刺客信条：英灵殿》转变为这种更现代的形态，变得像是一款准RPG。

paragraphs.en: “All of these games continue to reset player expectations, which means I think looking only to the original Fable trilogy for inspiration would leave us lacking in terms of what the modern audience, the modern marketplace, expects.”
paragraphs.cn: 「所有这些游戏都在不断重塑玩家的期待，这意味着我认为，如果只从《神鬼寓言》原版三部曲中寻找灵感，我们就无法充分满足现代受众和现代市场的期待。」

paragraphs.en: Fable is set for launch on February 23, 2027, across PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X and S.
paragraphs.cn: 《神鬼寓言》定于2027年2月23日登陆PC、PS5以及XBOX Series X和S。
